geoDesc: GeoOpt-Net uses SE(3)-equivariant, multifidelity learning to map inexpensive force-field conformers directly toward DFT-quality molecular geometries in one deterministic forward pass.

irDesc: A functional-group-centered learning strategy that uses local structural context to improve the accuracy, robustness, and interpretability of infrared-spectrum prediction.
